dialogues.speaker: Adeptus's Notes (I)
dialogues.text: "...The branch she planted keeps growing. It seems the water and soil in the cave are quite nutritious... Maybe in a few years, once it grows a little bigger, that medicine jar will be too small for this young tree..."

dialogues.speaker: Adeptus's Notes (I)
dialogues.text: "...She connected the door-opening mechanism with the jar the branch is planted in, breathing life-giving adeptal energy into said mechanism..."

dialogues.speaker: Adeptus's Notes (I)
dialogues.text: "...It seems the jar containing the mechanism was damaged a long time ago. I wonder if the door can still open and close..."
